name: Mahabhulekh (7/12 & 8A Land Records)
description: Maharashtra land record portal to view and download 7/12 (Satbara) and 8A extracts online.
eligibility: Landowners / general public for non-certified view; certified copies per process.
benefits: Instant access to land ownership, tenure, and mutation status; supports loans and transactions.
processing_time: Instant view; certified copy per taluka office process.
fees: Free view; nominal fee for certified copies.
validity: Reflects current records; mutations update over time.

faq.a: It is the land record showing ownership, area, crop, and tenure of a plot in Maharashtra.

ai_summary: Mahabhulekh provides online Maharashtra land records (7/12, 8A) for ownership and mutation status.
ai_explanation: Mahabhulekh is Maharashtra's revenue land record system. Citizens search by district, village, and survey number to view/download the 7/12 (Satbara) extract showing ownership, crop, and tenure, and the 8A for khata details. Certified copies come from the taluka office.
common_questions: How do I get 7/12 online in Maharashtra?
How do I check land mutation status?
Where do I get a certified 7/12?
common_mistakes: Relying on uncertified copy for legal use
suggested_followups: How do I apply for mutation in Maharashtra?
